name: Spektakl? Spektakl!
source:
Semyon has lots of problems. The shift is coming to an end, and he has no idea what his fate will be when that happens. Even the play that his friends have come up with is on the verge of collapse.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2479475874]Steam[/url]]
translation:
谢苗有很多问题。转变即将结束，他不知道当这种情况发生时他的命运会是什么。就连他的朋友们想出的戏也濒临崩溃。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2479475874]Steam[/url]]
